user_story: As a user, I want to verify the accessibility and integrity of images on the Broken Images page so that I can ensure that images are displayed correctly and are accessible to all users. Acceptance Criteria: 1. The page has a title 'The Internet'. 2. The heading 'Broken Images' is visible. 3. The page includes image elements, and broken images should not be displayed. 4. The footer 'Powered by Elemental Selenium' is visible.
